active_method: mHC and its no-manifold ablation; original LayerNorm/tanh HC remains archived
version_reason: This official release includes the complete prenorm forward/backward and autograd wrappers. v2 moved prenorm GEMM to DeepGEMM and removed mHC modeling wrappers.
integration_choices: fuse_grad_acc=False for normal PyTorch gradient accumulation
n_splits=1 matches the official TileLang prenorm implementation
contiguous head slice before kernel call
same documented local initialization and nanochat optimizer
On locally validated SM120, use official Sinkhorn backward token_block_size=16 via a thin autograd adapter; official SM90/SM100 wrapper retains tile32
runtime: runtime/pyproject.toml + uv.lock; independent CUDA 13.1 compiler/headers in toolchain/pyproject.toml + uv.lock
hardware: Upstream documents SM90/SM100. Local full gate and two 50-step smokes passed on SM120 RTX PRO 6000, tile16/repeat20; other GPU architectures unvalidated.
no_manifold_ablation: Bypass Sinkhorn only; retain identical parameters, initialization, pre/post gating, final head and optimizer. Use official individual operations for inference to avoid fused Sinkhorn.
